title: ICE and OKX Set Nov. 23 Tokenized Stock Launch After 67 Companies Opt Out
summary: Bitcoin Magazine ICE and OKX Set Nov. 23 Tokenized Stock Launch After 67 Companies Opt Out The joint venture will offer more than 70 assets, including tokenized shares of Strategy, Coinbase and Circle plus 59 Direxion ETFs, even after Tesla, Apple, Meta and Netflix objected. This post ICE and OKX Set Nov. 23 Tokenized Stock Launch After 67 Companies Opt Out first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
